attributes.axis_log: The pre-kit cap's residual label ('a five-GPR saved-web cycle, one promoted-width clrrwi/rlwinm seam, and tail parallel-array store scheduling') is CORRECT; its numbers are STALE (it records fuzzy 79.273384 / real 94, which attempt.register-item-wobj-semantic-tail-closure.20260829.v1 had already superseded to 85.21583 / real 74 -- the park was never re-stamped, and this record does that). Re-measured baseline: T139/O139, real 74, opcode multiset IDENTICAL (0t), SLOT MAP IDENTICAL. Reading the entry from the aligned view named the web precisely: target colours r31=runtime, r30=i, r29=value, r28=type, r27=target, r26=offset, i.e. the induction offset LAST, below all three parameter homes; ours coloured r31=runtime, r30=i, r29=offset, r28=value, r27=type, r26=target, i.e. the offset SECOND, above them -- a clean rotation of {r26..r29} with `i` and `runtime` already correct on both sides. That pinpointed `offset` as the intruder rather than any parameter, which is what made the induction axis the right one: the target has no such variable, it has a compiler-generated scaled index (visible as the tail's `stfsx f31,r31,r26`). The prior cap had closed `offset`'s TYPE, its declaration/init chronology, its scoping and its register class -- but never its EXISTENCE, and the function's own tail (runtime->wobjX[i] = x, etc.) was already indexing the same four typed arrays, so the raw-offset loop was reconstruction debt rather than a matched shape. Deleting it took real 74->60. It is also a genuine de-fakematch conversion: six raw-cast sites over four GC-verified typed members of the local ItemRuntime record, retiring debt in the TU with the heaviest raw-offset count in the census.

attributes.residual: MIXED. (a) The remaining multiset delta is a single addressing-mode flip in the tail: target `stfsx f31,r31,r26` against our `stfs`, i.e. the target still keeps a live scaled index register across the tail's four parallel-array stores where ours now folds one to a displacement. This is the cost side of the conversion and is 1 token against the 14 points of `real` it bought. (b) The entry schedule still differs in placement rather than content: target sinks `addi r4,r27,0` INSIDE the error branch and narrows `clrlwi r6,r28,24` at the point of use, while ours hoists both onto the common path -- content-identical, position-different. (c) The parameter homes remain rotated one register down (ours r26/r27/r28 vs target r27/r28/r29). HANDOFF to the harvest lane: (b) and (c) are a mixed schedule+recolor residual on an instruction-count-exact, slot-exact function with a 2-token multiset -- the classic postprocessor-eligible shape -- and the source-side axis list is now long and well documented (the prior cap closed eight axes; this session closed two more).
